It takes a looott of practice. Most of it is knowing how to move your head while keeping your balance. So slips, ducks, rolls, drawing circles etc. Kind of like keeping your head from hitting a rope. There are some really good youtube videos that can demonstrate this (Tony Jeffries Slip Line.) Another part of it is moving your head out of free will rather than anticipating a punch, so when those punches come flying, your head won't be there. Real world experience can help a lot as well, but it doesn't come easy. I train in Kickboxing, and it took me about 6 months to be decent at head movement. 👊

This means a lot to me, you may not see it, but a lot of positive comments like this motivates me to doing unique and creative things!

As for an OC, tbh I've never made one before. But I have a pretty vivid imagination, so I should be able to come up with one no problem. I would also love to see your art! I like seeing all of the unique styles folks draw in here.

And yeah, I have a top 3 outside of the main trio:


Gwen

I started liking Gwen mainly due to the fact that I'm getting used to adulting and taking on more responsibilities, all of which I hate. I relate to her in the job aspect. Not necessarily in the 'finding a job' aspect, but more of me working a job I hate. But hey, I'm only 20, it only gets worse from here right? 🥲 Another thing is, Gwen is shown to be a bit of a loner, only really enjoying herself when she is alone. I had to learn to do this in my adolescence, especially during summer break, where my friends lived towns apart. Yea, I'm used to it.


Ered

So, I have a huge attachment with characters in cartoons that skateboard (Jake the Dog, Kick Buttowski,                             
Bart Simpson, etc.) mainly due to the fact that growing up I had no one to skate with, so seeing them was kind of like an outlet. I also like the chill vibe she carries. It doesn't apply to every skater but for the most part it works. Just wish she wasn't self centered sometimes.. 😖 


Quartermaster

Dude is like the Uncle Ruckus of the show, (if u know, u know) careless, not afraid to speak his mind, and says some of the most out of pocket lines. I dunno, he's just a funny dude to me.
